title: Drinking Alone Under the Moon
content_zh:
Li Bai raises a cup to the bright moon,
With his shadow, they become three.
The moon is not fond of drinking,
The shadow only follows my body in vain.
But for a while I will make the moon and shadow my companions.
We must enjoy ourselves before spring passes.
I sing, and the moon lingers.
I dance, and my shadow scatters.
So long as I am sober, we are happy together.
When I am drunk, we each go our separate ways.
Forever we will share this friendship without feelings,
Meeting again among the far-off River of Stars.
